mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_contract_template WHERE use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY template_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_employment_contract ( contract_no, user_id, template_id, contract_type_cd, start_dt, end_dt, workplace, job_description, work_hours_per_week, work_start_time, work_end_time, break_minutes, weekly_holiday, annual_paid_leave_days, probation_months, salary_contract_id, insurance_applied_json, special_terms, status_cd, attach_group_id ) VALUES ( #{contractNo}, #{userId}, #{templateId}, #{contractTypeCd}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{workplace}, #{jobDescription}, COALESCE(#{workHoursPerWeek}, 40), #{workStartTime}, #{workEndTime}, COALESCE(#{breakMinutes}, 60), #{weeklyHoliday}, COALESCE(#{annualPaidLeaveDays}, 15), COALESCE(#{probationMonths}, 0), #{salaryContractId}, #{insuranceAppliedJson}, #{specialTerms}, COALESCE(#{statusCd}, 'DRAFT'), #{attachGroupId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE gw_employment_contract SET workplace = #{workplace}, job_description = #{jobDescription}, work_hours_per_week = #{workHoursPerWeek}, work_start_time = #{workStartTime}, work_end_time = #{workEndTime}, break_minutes = #{breakMinutes}, annual_paid_leave_days = #{annualPaidLeaveDays}, special_terms = #{specialTerms}, salary_contract_id = #{salaryContractId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
UPDATE gw_employment_contract SET employee_signed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, employee_signature = #{signature}, status_cd = 'SIGNED', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE contract_id = #{contractId}
mapper.select: SELECT ec.*, u.name AS user_name, u.email, d.dept_nm, t.template_nm, sc.annual_salary FROM gw_employment_contract ec JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = ec.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_contract_template t ON t.template_id = ec.template_id LEFT JOIN gw_salary_contract sc ON sc.contract_id = ec.salary_contract_id WHERE ec.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT ec.*, u.name AS user_name, u.email, d.dept_nm, t.template_nm, sc.annual_salary FROM gw_employment_contract ec JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = ec.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_contract_template t ON t.template_id = ec.template_id LEFT JOIN gw_salary_contract sc ON sc.contract_id = ec.salary_contract_id WHERE 1=1
AND (LOWER(u.name) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%') OR LOWER(ec.contract_no) LIKE LOWER('%' || #{keyword} || '%'))
AND ec.status_cd = #{status}
ORDER BY ec.created_at DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT ec.*, u.name AS user_name, u.email, d.dept_nm, t.template_nm, sc.annual_salary FROM gw_employment_contract ec JOIN gw_user u ON u.user_id = ec.user_id LEFT JOIN gw_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id LEFT JOIN gw_contract_template t ON t.template_id = ec.template_id LEFT JOIN gw_salary_contract sc ON sc.contract_id = ec.salary_contract_id WHERE ec.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ec.created_at DESC
